anchors.SQL: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'kind',kind,'type',arch_type,'module',arch_module,'fingerprint',fingerprint,'root',root_id,'src',src,'dst',dst,'undirected',undirected,'props',CAST(props AS JSON),'src_type',src_type,'dst_type',dst_type) FROM anchors ORDER BY id

graph_types.SQL: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('type_name',type_name,'ancestor',ancestor) FROM graph_types ORDER BY type_name,ancestor
